description: Saves an audience for campaigns, with a name, the WhatsApp number it is for and who it names (contact tags and that number’s chat labels, any or all), and returns it with its id, the audience.segment_id a campaign takes. It sends nothing and messages nobody. The audience is on the Campaigns page of the Cosend dashboard too. Campaigns are on the Starter plan and above, and for owners and admins.
name: create_audience
title: Save an audience for campaigns
